> Is there a way to get more information dumped when this happens?

Check `Console.app` (in `Applications` → `Utilities`) for a traces captured by OS (`Crash Reports` section).

Ha! Indeed. I found 3 crashes in there, but they're all very long to copy-paste, so I zipped them up:

[Godot Crashes.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28698072/Godot.Crashes.zip)

It seems to be related to the loading of a specific mesh (or related to threaded resource loader issues - https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/119757, https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/120077), so will require reproduction project to check it further.

Okay! That pointed me in the right direction. I noticed it started to crash along the same time I added a new placeholder mesh to the game. This cheese burger: [burger-cheese.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28703365/burger-cheese.zip) It's probably not about the mesh itself, but how I add it to the scene. I needed to be able to add a material override to the mesh, so I copied the meshes from the scene created by the importer, and inserted them into my scene like this: This seems to cause a crash. If I just drag the object into the scene like this however... ... then its fine. Although it's not useful for me in this way. I didn't have this issue with other meshes, so I'll keep digging.
